description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among 12 labeled data sources. The slices are labeled with percentages via callouts around the chart, and there is no separate legend; none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized. The largest slice is an unlabeled gray category at about 31.3%, followed by FEVER in teal at about 16.1%, SNLI in orange at about 15.4%, VITAMINC in light cyan at about 13.0%, and MULTINLI in salmon/pink at about 11.3%. Smaller slices include ANLI in orange at about 4.6%, FACTCC in yellow at about 2.6%, ENTFA in green at about 1.8%, XSUMHUL in very light blue at about 1.6%, SCITAIL in greenish-teal at about 1.2%, and two very small slices, PUBHEALTH in pale yellow at about 0.5% and MULTIFC in light blue at about 0.5%, plus SCIFACT in a very thin sliver at about 0.1%. The slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment on the right through progressively smaller segments around the circle, with several small categories clustered on the right side.
